headline: Vote on committee chair and vice chair, plus discussion of CDBG program, scoring rules, and HUD news.
summary: The agenda includes an overview of the CDBG program and talks on needs, goals, and priorities. Scoring rules, the application and rubric, and changes to the rules are also listed, along with HUD news.
